profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer and Dev Lead at Blackbaud
profile.summary:
Who Am I:
• A Software Engineer at Blackbaud with an interest in Web Development through both Front-End and Back-End development.

What I've Done
• I'm a Software Engineer at Blackbaud with a focus on fit-and-finish work, customer satisfaction, and customer retention. 
• I have interned at Blackbaud in Summer 2016 and Summer 2017. During the first summer I implemented data analytics to monitor usage of a legacy product so that Blackbaud can migrate needed features to their new platform. This project ended up being deployed into three of Blackbaud's flagship products. The next summer I created a new feature to track banking history while working alongside a sprint team.

If you are seeking a Software Developer that ensures a project gets finished and exceeds expectations then...

Contact Me:
Thomas Ortiz ❖ thomasortiz95@gmail.com ❖ 919-999-8405 ❖ github.com/ThomasOrtiz

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Financial Solutions
positions.description:
● Led team of 7 engineers to deliver multiple high-impact projects on time and within budget
● Integrated AI-powered tools into development lifecycle to streamline code generation, automate code reviews, and extract feature requirements from legacy systems
● Modernized monolithic legacy accounting system to Azure cloud-based microservices and Angular SPAs
● Collaborated with Product Management, UX, and Architecture teams to define, plan, and ship new features
● Built internal developer tools that improved team efficiency and productivity 
● Championed coding standards and fostered cross-team collaboration through volunteer participation in developer leadership committees
● Contributed to talent acquisition through recruiting outreach, technical interviews, and candidate evaluation
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · Microservices · Angular · .NET Core · Azure Cosmos DB · Azure Service Bus · TypeScript · Azure DevOps · C# · Accounting

positions.title: Computer Science Research Assistant
positions.description:
Work on improving the way Computer Science courses are taught at NC State which involves data collection, data analysis, and automation. 

All CSC Classes 
Created a dashboard using Django to pull build information gathered from Jenkins' build scripts and present that output in a easily viewable format for students and teaching assistants. The goal behind this project was to present Jenkins output in an easily viewable format. Furthermore, the website, build scripts, and database configurations were built in such a way as to allow both modularity and  expandability for all courses in the CSC curriculum to utilize as they see fit.

CSC 116 - Intro To Java
Analyzing student  projects, assignments and tests across multiple sections of CSC 116 and comparing performance across sections, while keeping student data private and anonymous.

positions.title: Java Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisting students with learning concepts in java, grading In-Class-Exercises and projects, and holding office hours weekly to mentor students.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
During my second internship at Blackbaud I worked as a full-stack developer on their web platform Financial Edge Nxt (FENxt). I developed new features alongside a scrum team with a bi-weekly sprint schedule.

Specifically, my intern project was working in C# .Net for back-end work and then developing with AngularJS for the front-end. 

Bank Feeds Project:
The project's goal was to add  functionality so that users can see the status and history of a bank feed download process users can trigger. Before this project users would start the process and it would finish with minimal feedback. Once integrated, my tasks allowed users to see how and why processes succeeded or failed and provided a history log of each process.

After finishing my project I moved on to other sprint tasks with my team. Some examples of tasks I completed include optimizing end point tests, bug fixing across the product, and additional feature implementations. 

During this internship I got more freedom to develop across the entire stack. I used C#, SQL, Javascript, jQuery, AngularJS, and other web technologies. The most helpful information I earned was learning how the entire stack operates.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
During my internship at Blackbaud, I developed on Blackbaud's leading product - Financial Edge 7 (FE7). I added data analytics by implementing Mixpanel into FE7 with Visual Basic 6. The goal of this project was to understand how customers utilize FE7 in order to port over the most used features into Financial Edge NXT (FENxt). 

After implementing data analytics into FE7 my implementation was adopted by two other leading products at Blackbaud - Raiser's Edge and Education Edge.


Afterwards, I developed for FENxt where I focused on non-profit intelligence and financial data analysis.

During this internship I learned and solidified the following skills: VB6, C#, SQL, javascript, jquery, angularJKS, and other web technologies.

projects.title: Base Converter
projects.description:
This small webapp is an extension of my website that I decided to make to gain experience with AngularJS. 

        Often in my classes I would convert between different numeric bases and would often use online converters to double check my work.This tool was made as a convenience for me so that I am able to quickly navigate to a base converter to quickly check over conversions.

projects.title: Door To More - 4th Place Winner
projects.description:
Off The Grid : Blackbaud. Summer 2016 - Semi-finalist

Door To More was created in 24 hours to benefit advocacy organizations that would employ individuals to canvass door to door or on the street to raise awareness, solicit donations, and add to in-house files. The purpose of the app is to create a streamlined interface where canvassers can quickly create new constituents and document the interaction in a way that advocacy organizations can aggregate or target these constituents in the future.
